known_constraints: train_general.py has no --intermediate-size flag: intermediate_size comes from PRESETS, so a non-reference plan needs the one-line PRESETS entry carried in `preset_patch`.
intermediate_size is searched on a multiple-of-8 grid; BitLinear needs (intermediate x hidden) % 256 == 0 for block-scaled gamma, which multiples of 8 satisfy at hidden 512 and at hidden 64.
tile counts must be multiples of 4 to hold the 3:1 mamba:attn ratio exactly.
